observed: The exact first-turn Catalog admitted action_results_next_page from an AgentContext delivery-planning inventory. The committed StepResult carried that typed continuation and the admitted ModelTurnDelivery, but the authoritative RunState.delivery_store still lacked the inventory, so its sole reducer classified the admitted capability as unsupported.
expected: A continuation accepted from the exact admitted turn must be reducible exactly once against the authoritative previous Store, preserve every independent transition, and require neither a whole-Store policy handoff nor a caller-side merge.
producer: ContextBuilder.build_action_delivery_plan derives the per-turn inventory-backed AgentContext Store
TurnPacker/ModelTurnDelivery publishes the admitted continuation capability
Catalog resolver returns the typed continuation on the existing LocalToolResult
owner: ObservationDeliveryStore owns retained evidence and continuation currentness
ObservationDeliveryStore.reduce(previous_store, committed_step) owns the sole next Store transition
consumer: the next TurnPacker consumes the advanced continuation inventory
violated_invariant: Every typed continuation admitted by the exact current Catalog has one authoritative inventory/currentness lineage available to the sole committed-step reducer.
contract_gap: The frozen contract does not specify how the admitted per-turn delivery inventory becomes an authoritative reducer input before the reducer validates a continuation selected from that same turn.
stop_action: No nearby branch, compatibility fallback, Store merge, live run, or benchmark specialization was added. Atomic cutover remains uncommitted and work stopped at the owner boundary.
